gamma_tweaks.setting.gamma.tooltip: Overrides the video Brightness option, reaching past vanilla's Bright.
gamma_tweaks.setting.fullbright.tooltip: Treats every block as if it is fully lit.
gamma_tweaks.setting.sunlight.tooltip: Turn off to remove the sun's light, like being underground.
gamma_tweaks.setting.overlay.tooltip: Draws the light level on top of the blocks around you.
gamma_tweaks.setting.spawnable_only.tool: Shows only blocks dark enough for mobs to spawn on.
gamma_tweaks.setting.radius.tooltip: How far around you the overlay reaches.
